Bill.BriefDescription: Changing provisions relating to county law library funding.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to county law library funding; and amending RCW27.24.070.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 27.24.070 and 1992 c 54 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In each county that maintains a county or regional law librarypursuant to this chapter, the county treasurer shall deposit in thecounty or regional law library fund a sum equal to twelve dollars forevery new probate or civil filing fee, including appeals, collected bythe clerk of the superior court and six dollars for every fee collectedfor the commencement of a civil action in district court for thesupport of the law library in that county or the regional law libraryto which the county belongs((: PROVIDED, That)). (2) Upon a showing of need the twelve dollar contribution depositedfor each superior court filing fee under subsection (1) of this sectionmay be increased to up to fifteen dollars for each such fee upon therequest of the law library board of trustees and with the approval ofthe county legislative body or bodies. p. 1 SB 5882 (3) Upon a showing of need by the law library board of trustees, acounty legislative body or bodies may impose a surcharge not to exceedfifteen dollars on every new probate or civil filing, includingappeals, in superior court for the purpose of funding the county lawlibrary. Any surcharge imposed shall be collected by the clerk of thecourt and remitted to the county treasurer for deposit in the county orregional law library fund. However, no surcharge under this subsectionis valid if, before imposing the surcharge, a county has increased thecontribution as allowed under subsection (2) of this section and thenhas reduced such contribution before or after imposing the surcharge.
